question: What is Arista Networks, what is our verdict for new capital and existing shares, and what breaks the thesis?

epigraph.quote: In investing, what is comfortable is rarely profitable.
epigraph.author: Robert Arnott

web_blocks.html: Business Quality (`COMPOUNDER_PASS`, `PASS_WITH_WATCH`): Arista Networks (NYSE: ANET) is a top asset-light software and switching compounder [1][9]. Its gear powers hyperscale cloud and AI back-end Ethernet networks [1][9]. Over ten years, sales compounded ~26% a year from $1.13 billion in FY2016 to $9.01 billion in FY2025 [1]. Growth then sped up +44.3% YoY to $9.40 billion in 9M 2026 [2]. Q3 2026 revenue hit $3.66 billion (+58.5% YoY) with a 44.9% GAAP operating margin [3]. In FY2025, free cash flow hit $4.25 billion, or 124.5% of net income and a 47.2% margin [1]. ROIC stands at 28.89%, backed by $14.36 billion in cash and securities with zero debt [1][2][22]. Still, KPI health carries a watch flag for three reasons. Microsoft (26%) and Meta (16%) drive 42% of sales, while non-cancellable purchase commitments stand at $11.4 billion [1][2]. NVIDIA Spectrum-X also surged in Q1 2026 Ethernet share [16].

WAIT FOR SUPPORT — New Capital Verdict (`WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT`, `TIER_2` `CORE_ALPHA`): ANET trades at $197.29, or 32.60x Forward P/E and a 0.91 PEG [22]. Our Reverse-DCF model shows that price implies a 16.0% 10-year revenue CAGR. ANET holds a weekly Stage 2 structure tempered by a daily Stage 3 pullback signal inside a `Correction` market [23]. Our 12–18 month probability-weighted expected value is $231.85 (+17.5%). A $242.00 Base target yields 1.95:1 reward-to-risk from the $195.82 support ceiling against a $172.09 stop. Skip any immediate CMP starter tranche. Stage limit bids only inside the $183.59–$195.82 support zone or wait for a confirmed Stage 2 breakout resumption above $206.63 on expanding volume.

KEEP COMPOUNDING — Existing Holding Action (`31.628949` shares, `$6,240.07`, `7.04%` weight): Hold all 21.4341 Schwab shares and 10.194849 Robinhood shares with zero immediate sales (`holding_shares_to_sell: 0`). Enforce a hard structural exit at $172.09. Trim 10.5 shares (~1/3) at $242.00 if portfolio weight exceeds 9.0%. Cut 50% if mid-February 2027 earnings lower the ~$18.5 billion FY2027 revenue outlook.

book_paragraphs: Arista Networks is the networking backbone of the artificial intelligence buildout. While chipmakers design the processors that train AI models, Arista builds the ultra-fast Ethernet switches and the clean, single-binary operating system that link tens of thousands of those processors into a single working supercomputer. Over the past decade, Arista grew revenue roughly tenfold—from $1.13 billion in 2016 to $9.01 billion in 2025—and just posted 58.5% year-over-year growth in Q3 2026 with a 44.9% GAAP operating margin and $14.36 billion in debt-free cash.

At $197.29 per share, the stock is not cheap on trailing earnings, yet our Reverse DCF shows the price only asks for 16.0% annual revenue growth over the next decade—well below management's 38% to 48% near-term trajectory. On the weekly chart, Arista holds a Stage 2 structure above its rising 30-week average, though its daily chart shows a Stage 3 pullback inside a market correction. For new capital, our verdict is Wait for Support—skipping any immediate starter buy at $197.29 until shares test $183.59–$195.82 support or reclaim $206.63 on expanding volume—with a $172.09 stop and a $242.00 base target; for the 31.63 shares you already own, our verdict is Keep Compounding.
